name: FND_DIAG_TAG_VALUE_TEST_ASSOC
description: This table stores assignments of diagnostics tests to various tag value id's (TAG_VALUE_ID's represent "nodes" in the "taxonomy structure")

columns.name: TAG_VALUE_ID
columns.description: An ID equivalent to Taxonomy Module ID, used to define nodes in the Taxonomy Structure.

columns.name: TAG_TYPE
columns.description: Defines whether a Tag Value is extracted from Taxonomy (T), or defined within Diagnostcis framework (D).

columns.name: ACTIVE
columns.description: Flag to turn the Object On or Off - Allowed values are - "Y" for Active and "N" for Inactive.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Seed data file from which the row originates.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
